description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.dom.event class, which wraps native DOM event objects and provides methods to access event properties and control event behavior.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.event
classes.description: A class representing a native DOM event object, providing methods to access event details and control event propagation.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key code associated with the event.

methods.name: getKeystroke
methods.description: Returns a number representing the combination of keys pressed during the event, including control, shift, and alt modifiers.

methods.name: preventDefault
methods.description: Prevents the default action of the event and optionally stops propagation.

methods.name: stopPropagation
methods.description: Stops the event from propagating further.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Returns the DOM node where the event was targeted.
